item.title: Miami of Ohio finishes regular season 31-0 after 110-108 OT win at Ohio
item.description: ATHENS — No. 19 Miami of Ohio finished the regular season as the only unbeaten team in Division I men’s basketball, with Eian Elmer scoring a career-high 32 points and grabbing 12 rebounds in a gritty 110-108 overtime victory over Ohio on March 6. Peter Suder scored five of his 13 points in overtime for Miami (31-0, 18-0 Mid-American), which became the first team to complete an unblemished regular season since Gonzaga in 2021. Trey Perry added 21 points and Brant Byers scored 15 for the RedHawks
